column1: # Meridian Health Systems - Vendor Due Diligence Questionnaire v3.2

column3: Requirement
Confirm your organisation maintains a board- or owner-approved ethics policy and state its identifier.
Provide the effective date and next review date of your ethics programme.
Has your programme been verified by an accredited external assessor?
Confirm the absence of forced, bonded, indentured or trafficked labour across all tiers.
Confirm no recruitment fees are borne by workers and describe how this is verified.
State your policy on retention of worker identity documents.
Describe your approach to worker classification for non-employee personnel.
State the maximum weekly hours permitted including overtime.
Describe controls preventing facilitation payments.
State the approval threshold above which gifts and hospitality must be registered.
Describe your sanctions and denied-party screening process for third parties.
Provide the confidential reporting channel available to workers and third parties.
Confirm anonymous reporting is supported and describe non-retaliation protection.
State the languages in which a concern may be raised.
Describe the compliance training curriculum and its frequency.
Provide completion rates for the most recent 12-month period.
Provide your information security policy identifier and approval date.
List any security certifications held (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HITRUST).
State your breach notification commitment to customers.
Confirm whether a BAA is executed where PHI is processed.
Describe encryption applied in transit and at rest.
Provide the last test date of your business continuity plan.
Provide Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions for the most recent reporting year.
List environmental certifications held.
Describe flow-down of buyer requirements to subcontractors.
